name: Cannabis Use Disorders Identification Test, Revised
developer: Adamson, Kay-Lambkin, Baker, Lewin, Thornton, Kelly and Sellman (2010)
construct: Hazardous cannabis use and possible cannabis use disorder over the past 6 months.
licence: "This protocol is freely available; permission not required for use." (PhenX Toolkit)
instructions: Have you used any cannabis over the past six months? YES / NO. If YES, please answer the following questions about your cannabis use. Circle the response that is most correct for you in relation to your cannabis use over the past six months

items.text: How often do you use cannabis?
items.note: Response options: Never = 0; Monthly or less = 1; 2-4 times a month = 2; 2-3 times a week = 3; 4 or more times a week = 4

items.text: How many hours were you "stoned" on a typical day when you had been using cannabis?
items.note: Response options: Less than 1 = 0; 1 or 2 = 1; 3 or 4 = 2; 5 or 6 = 3; 7 or more = 4

items.text: How often during the past 6 months did you find that you were not able to stop using cannabis once you had started?
items.note: Response options: Never = 0; Less than monthly = 1; Monthly = 2; Weekly = 3; Daily or almost daily = 4

items.text: How often during the past 6 months did you fail to do what was normally expected from you because of using cannabis?
items.note: Response options: Never = 0; Less than monthly = 1; Monthly = 2; Weekly = 3; Daily or almost daily = 4

items.text: How often in the past 6 months have you devoted a great deal of your time to getting, using, or recovering from cannabis?
items.note: Response options: Never = 0; Less than monthly = 1; Monthly = 2; Weekly = 3; Daily or almost daily = 4

items.text: How often in the past 6 months have you had a problem with your memory or concentration after using cannabis?
items.note: Response options: Never = 0; Less than monthly = 1; Monthly = 2; Weekly = 3; Daily or almost daily = 4

items.text: How often do you use cannabis in situations that could be physically hazardous, such as driving, operating machinery, or caring for children:
items.note: Response options: Never = 0; Less than monthly = 1; Monthly = 2; Weekly = 3; Daily or almost daily = 4

items.text: Have you ever thought about cutting down, or stopping, your use of cannabis?
items.note: Response options: Never = 0; Yes, but not in the past 6 months = 2; Yes, during the past 6 months = 4

scoring: "This questionnaire was designed for self-administration and is scored by adding each of the 8 items: Question 1-7 are scored on a 0-4 scale" and "Question 8 is scored 0, 2 or 4" (total 0 to 32). Higher scores indicate more problematic use. "Scores of 8 or more indicate hazardous cannabis use, while scores of 12 or more indicate a possible cannabis use disorder for which further intervention may be required."
citation: Adamson, S. J., Kay-Lambkin, F. J., Baker, A. L., Lewin, T. J., Thornton, L., Kelly, B. J., & Sellman, J. D. (2010). An improved brief measure of cannabis misuse: The Cannabis Use Disorders Identification Test-Revised (CUDIT-R). Drug and Alcohol Dependence, 110(1–2), 137–143. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.drugalcdep.2010.02.017
transcriptionNote: Items transcribed from the PhenX Toolkit protocol page. The response scale differs by item: items 1, 2 and 8 have item specific options (given in each item note); items 3 to 7 share the frequency scale listed in responseOptions. Item 7 ends with a colon in the source. The screening question (past 6 months use, YES/NO) precedes the 8 items. The 4 content areas named in the target record (consumption, cannabis problems, dependence, psychological features) are not assigned to items on the PhenX page, so only a Total is listed. The PhenX page also carries a note that protocols may include language that could be triggering to respondents.
